_meta.doc: A/B experiment registry. Loaded by static/js/experiments.js. Each experiment has an id, status (active|paused|draft), and variants whose traffic must sum to 100. Bucketing is deterministic on (te_uid, experiment_id) — same user always gets the same variant for a given experiment, but bucketing across experiments is independent.
_meta.schema: see static/js/experiments.js for full schema docstring

experiments.doc: CONTAMINATED — paused 2026-05-23 after A.5 audit found cookie-timing bug. tracker.js deferred te_uid cookie write to first interaction; experiments.js read it eagerly on first impression, minting a different ephemeral UUID. Same user appeared in both variants (57 users, 19 days of data). Replaced by harness_aa_v2 after tracker.js fix. Historical data preserved for analysis but ALL harness_aa_v1 stats are invalid. Original goal: A/A test to validate the end-to-end harness — bucketing → tracker.js event.exp → worker events.experiments column → analyze_experiments.py. Audit ref: §4.A7 step 1, A.5 root-cause report.

v2, post tracker.js fix. Same A/A structure as harness_aa_v1 (control_a vs control_b, 50/50). Restarted after the cookie-timing bug was fixed: tracker.js now writes te_uid eagerly at page load instead of deferring to first click/scroll, so experiments.js reads the same UUID on the first impression. New experiment ID produces fresh bucketing for every user (deterministic hash includes experiment_id, so old users with cached te_uid get a clean re-assignment). Run analyze_experiments.py after a few days; expect impressions and clicks roughly equal across variants. If the A/A passes, harness is validated and Stream A.3 (Re1 MMR treatment) can proceed.
